subject.title: claude-sonnet-5 missing from bundled Anthropic model catalog / GA-1M-context prefix list

question: Which open Sonnet 5 implementation should be the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but multiple open PRs overlap on the fix and differ in whether they cover generated Claude CLI catalog and shared model-contract predicates.

options.title: Land the complete candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99463 or an equivalent patch if maintainers want the catalog, CLI catalog, aliases, and model-contract predicates covered together.

options.title: Land the narrow closing PR
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99313 for the core catalog/context bug and leave the generated CLI catalog and model-contract gaps to a separate tracked fix.

options.title: Wait for the broad rollout
options.body: Hold this issue until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98254 or another broad Sonnet 5 rollout becomes mergeable and proof-positive.

recommendation.title: Land the complete candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99463 or an equivalent patch if maintainers want the catalog, CLI catalog, aliases, and model-contract predicates covered together.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the current issue assignee and has recent adjacent Anthropic stream-wrapper history, making them the best available owner for selecting the canonical PR path.
